title: Respectful Petition Letter Writer for Village Road Repair
title_te: గ్రామ రోడ్డు మరమ్మత్తు కోసం గౌరవప్రదమైన వినతి లేఖ
problem: Rainwater creates deep muddy holes on our hostel road, but elders do not know how to write a formal request letter to district officers.
idea: A petition letter helper. We give Gemini the problem details and it writes a polite, formal letter. The checklist makes sure the letter has every important part.

widgets.heading: 📝 Parts of a Good Petition Letter

items.title: From & To
items.text: Our names and village at the top. Then 'To, The Panchayat Secretary, [village]'.
items.te: పైన మా పేర్లు, ఊరు. తర్వాత 'గౌరవనీయులైన పంచాయతీ కార్యదర్శి గారికి'.

items.title: Subject
items.text: One line: 'Request to repair the road near our school hostel'.
items.te: ఒక లైన్: 'హాస్టల్ దగ్గర రోడ్డు మరమ్మత్తు కోసం వినతి'.

items.title: Problem
items.text: Where, since when, and how it troubles people. Be polite and exact.
items.te: ఎక్కడ, ఎప్పటి నుండి, ఎలా ఇబ్బంది – మర్యాదగా, స్పష్టంగా.

items.title: Request
items.text: Clearly ask what you want done.

items.title: Signatures & date
items.text: Date, signatures of many villagers, and attach photos.
items.te: తేదీ, గ్రామస్తుల సంతకాలు, ఫోటోలు జత చేయండి.

widgets.heading: ✅ Is Our Letter Ready to Submit?

items.text: We kept a copy with the office stamp / received sign
items.te: ఆఫీసు ముద్రతో ఒక కాపీ మా దగ్గర ఉంచుకున్నాం

bands.text: Good. Add the missing parts to make it stronger.

how: Take clear photos of the damaged road and note the exact location.
Talk to elders and write down: since when, who is affected, what we request.
Type these details into Gemini and ask it to write a polite formal petition letter.
Ask Gemini for a Telugu version too, and read both with a teacher.
Print the letter, collect signatures from villagers, and attach the photos.
Give it to the Panchayat Secretary and ask for a stamped copy as proof.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student. Write a short, polite formal petition letter to the Panchayat Secretary of [village] requesting repair of the road near our school hostel. Details: [deep muddy holes after rain, since July, children fall, autos can't come]. Include From, To, Subject, problem, request and space for signatures. Give it in English and simple Telugu.
